resources.string: Hold volume down at the lowest media volume to zoom into 10 finer steps.

Volume Zoom watches only the volume keys. When media is at its lowest audible step, hold volume down to zoom into 10 extra, quieter steps (software attenuation of the media output). Volume up steps back out. No other input or screen content is read.
Android 13+ blocks accessibility for sideloaded apps until you open App info, tap the ⋮ menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".

Lower media volume to its last step, then hold volume down to zoom in (starts at 0 dB). Each down press is one fine step quieter; up steps back out. A fresh press on the last fine step mutes. A quick press at the last step still mutes as usual.
Service: disabled. Enable \"Volume Zoom\" in accessibility settings.
Deepest fine step: −%1$d dB (%2$.1f dB per step)
Hold time to zoom in: %1$d ms
Volume keys control media when nothing is playing (Pixel default; turn off if idle keys change the ringer)
